titles: Children who Chase Lost Voices from Deep Below
I bambini che inseguono le stelle

source.description: Asuna Watase is the main character in Children Who Chase Lost Voices. She is an elementary schoolgirl living in a rural area in the 1970s.  As a young girl, Asuna has been forced to grow up quickly ever since her father had died, while her mother, a nurse, worked long shifts at a hospital. Asuna spent her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the cat's-whisker receiver her father gave to her as a memento, accompanied by pet cat Mimi.

Asuna's substitute teacher for the duration her teacher is on maternity leave.    ~!He seeks to find out more information on the mythology of the underworld and is looking for Agaruta. He hopes to be able to revive his dead wife Risa in Agartha. !~
Younger brother of Shun. He is from Canaan, a town in Agartha.   Asuna meets him after Shun. Shin comes to Asuna to continue what his older brother had been doing after Shun's disappearance.
A mysterious boy from Agartha who Asuna takes a liking to after he saves her from a mysterious creature. He is the older brother of Shin. His last song was heard by Asuna, and he then disappeared.
A little girl who stopped speaking after her mother, Dinah, died. Her father is a Topsider. Mana is from Amaurot, a town in Agartha.
The sister of Shun and Shin. She is from Canaan, a town in Agartha.
Asuna's mother. She is a nurse employed by a hospital and is not able to spend much time with Asuna. Because of this, their mother-daughter relationship is not so good.
Morisaki-sensei's wife who had a weak body and died.
An old man from Amaurot, a town in Agartha. He is the grandfather of Mana. His daughter, Dinah, married a man who was a Topsiders.
A cat who keeps Asuna company.    ~!Mimi is actually a Yadoriko from Agartha. !~
Asuna's father who died when she was very little.
A soldier from Amaurot, a town in Agartha.

**Age:** ~!~800 years!~
**Relatives:** [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) ("father"; creator), [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) (adoptive "mother"), [Gugu](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) (adoptive brother)

Fushi is an immortal being created by The Beholder and placed on Earth to preserve the world.

Fushi is an immortal being that can take the form of anything that has given him stimuli. His original form was a featureless white sphere. Without consciousness, he copied the first thing he bumped into, which happened to be a rock. Soon afterward, he became moss and stayed like that for some time. When a wounded wolf wandered close in the middle of winter and died, the immortal copied the wolf. He retains the ability to turn into these things. Later, after the death of the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Unnamed-Boy), he mimicked the boy's appearance and took the form of a young boy with white hair, a pale complexion, and green eyes. He wears a short, brown fur cloak and a light blue shirt and pants with fur boots. A rope dangled from his hand and neck as the nameless boy died holding [Joaan](https://anilist.co/character/163694/Joaan)'s leash, though the latter soon disappeared. Fushi commented on the form, saying it felt like it belonged to him the most.

Other than the nameless boy (whose form he usually defaults to), he can also take the form of many others; most notably: ~!March, a little girl with long black hair wearing a simple white dress; Gugu, a young man with defined muscle who hides his face behind a salamander mask; and [Parona](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona), a young woman with black hair and a slender body.!~

Fushi appears to be a good listener, is curious, brave, and a fast learner. Before learning how to speak, Fushi would learn how to do things by mimicking other people's actions. After learning how to express himself via words, Fushi speaks his mind - no matter how mean it may sound. He cares deeply for others and dislikes death. He also blames himself for the [Nokkers](https://anilist.co/character/232832/Nokkers)' attacks, believing that destruction follows wherever he goes. Fushi finds it extremely hard to make friends because he knows he will have to see their lives to the end; they will always die while he lives forever.
A girl from the present area. ~!She's one of [Hayase](https://anilist.co/character/136545/Hayase)'s descendants and will be the eighteenth leader of the Defense Corps.!~

**Relatives:** Unnamed [mother](https://anilist.co/character/202865/March-no-Haha) & [father](https://anilist.co/character/201554/March-no-Chichi), [Risa](https://anilist.co/character/202890/Risa) (baby sibling)

March is a young girl from Ninannah. When running away from her village, she stumbles across [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) near a pond.

March is very skilled at climbing trees. She's also small enough where she can easily crawl through tight spaces adults can't.

March was born in the village of Ninannah. Years later, she is chosen as a sacrifice to the [Spirit Bear](https://anilist.co/character/202861/Oniguma), a god her village worships to bring peace and prosperity, but is rescued by [Parona](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona).

**Relatives:** Unnamed mother, father, and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/201557/Paronas-sister).

Parona is a girl from Ninannah and a close friend of [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March). She looks after March like an older sister.

__Affiliation:__ Tonari's Group (former)

Tonari is a girl that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. She has short brown hair, green eyes, and tan skin. She's seen wearing a blue jacket and shorts, a black and white shirt, and has a pet owl named Ligard. 

~!Sometime after Fushi left the island of Jananda, Tonari began ingesting different types of poison to develop strong immunities to them.!~

The mysterious being and observer who cast the orb onto the Earth. His goal is to preserve the world. He sent [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to acquire various kinds of information from the world and aid his observations.

Gugu is a young man from Takunaha who originally worked at [Booze Man's](https://anilist.co/character/136555/Sakejii) shop. As [Fushi's](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) sworn brother, he fought the [Nokkers](https://anilist.co/character/232832/Nokkers) and anti-Fushi faction members on several occasions to create the peaceful world the immortal desires.

He wears a mask to hide his face.

~!His head got crushed by a wood log while trying to save [Rean](https://anilist.co/character/136551/Cropp-Rean). He has been wearing a mask to cover it ever since.!~
Pyoran is an old woman from Takunaha. She comes to Ninannah as a shaman.
Kahaku is the sixth successor of the Defense Corps and the first male successor of [Hayase](https://anilist.co/character/136545/Hayase)'s will.

source.description: Yamagami's first name is so long it is often abbreviated to just "Lucy". Her parents had difficulty choosing a name and listed all the ideas on the registration form. This becomes an ongoing embarrassment for her and she proclaims that she became a civil servant only to exact revenge on the sloppy bureaucrat that approved her name! She becomes angry when people refer to her by first name (or any abbreviation).  Her full first name (or at least as much as she bothered listing) is: Lucy Kimiko Akie Airi Shiori Rinne Yoshiho Ayano Tomika Chitose Sanae Mikiko Ichika.

A 3rd generation city employee, who works at the city welfare department, he is assigned to the 1st section that issues nursing certifications. He claims to be good at almost everything and he is quite a charmer that he can get email addresses from pretty clients, even boasting about it to his superior, Taishi. Though, a slacker he wouldn't hesitate to go out of his way to help out Yamagami and Saya when they're having trouble dealing with difficult clients. He always teases Yamagami that he would find himself earning her ire.

She is a shy and passive newly hired city employee, who, along with her fellow newbies  Hasebe and Yamagami works at the city welfare department. She is assigned to the 2nd section that handles elderly concerns where part of her job is to listen to an elderly client's torturous  rambling.    (Source: ANN)

A social service employee who is actually working as a temporary employee with a shorter shift than others. She is rather aloof towards her co-workers, and is revealed to be an avid fan of the magical girl series Magical Flowers. When she is not at work, she attends cosplay events dressed as Gerbera Pink, one of the characters of the series. She openly desires to see Lucy cosplay as one of the other characters from "Magical Flowers" due to her dark hair and large bust. She hates Hasebe getting too close to Lucy in case he convinces her to cosplay before she does.

~!She has been dating Ichimiya for over a year, and has tried to make it clear to him that she doesn't care if he prioritizes Tohko on Christmas because of comiket.!~

Taishi is a supervisor in the health and welfare office and the one in charge of Lucy and her friends. Although kind and approachable, Taishi is prone to be bossed around, particularly by his sister.

~!He has been dating Chihaya for over a year, but worries about getting dumped before Christmas, since Toko's birthday is on the same day and he always prioritizes Toko, though Chihaya, due to her own Christmas cosplay commitments, doesn't seem to care.!~

Taishi's tsundere younger sister, noted for having a peculiar marking under her right eye similar to the "bulging vein" image used to depict a person when angry. Staying true to this quirky trait, Tōhko is often in a bad mood and has a short temper. On the other hand, she seems to have a brother complex. Ever since learning about her older brother's interest in working as a public servant, Tōhko started learning more about the job, and by high school is knowledgeable enough to give surprise quizzes to employees every time she visits her brother's workplace. Her birthday is on Christmas Eve.

The Section Chief of the Health and Welfare Department. He is first introduced as a talking stuffed rabbit in episode 4 due to his extreme shyness. He sometimes falls prey, though, to the mood of his subordinates--and is either stomped on or has the fur plucked off of him like petals on a flower as a result. He is also an old friend of Hasebe's father.
The daughter of Kenzou Momoi. People say that she resembles him. She is also friends with Touko Ichimiya.

An old lady living in the ward who frequents the office to visit Miyoshi. She always talks about her daughter-in-law and has a grandson who happens to be Yutaka's childhood friend and rival. Although she tried to get Miyoshi to marry her grandson, she stops talking about him when she realizes that Miyoshi hates him.

Eiji is the protagonist of Big Order. He is indifferent towards everything around him and skips classes whenever he wants.   ~!Eiji is afraid to use his power because of it the whole world suffered great losses. As well as his sister who cant move her legs because of his wish.!~   ~!He has the power to mark places as his territory and make anything in his territory under his control. He gained this power after wishing for the destruction of the world due to the influence of the book 'the big baddie' where the protagonist wants to take over the world to bring about peace.!~

A transfer student whom Eiji has a crush on.    ~! Her Father and Mother were killed in the diaster 10 years ago caused by Eiji. She Swore Revenge and using her Order of Immortality, she Attempts to Assassinate Eiji. Failing after Eiji orders her to follow him and never attempt to kill him or his step-sister Sena again, she resolves to murder him herself using indirect means. !~
Eiji met her long time ago. Claims to be a 'fairy' who grants wishes.

He is the great hero, a unique existence in the world, destined to defeat evil. Due to this immense burden, Blade was never able to relate to other people nor form bonds of friendship with anyone, this being the reason for his obsession with being a normal person.

source.description:
Tomie enjoys the effect her beauty has on men, and seeks to seduce them, but feels no emotional attachment to any of her lovers. Once she no longer has an immediate use for a man, she'll discard him, a pattern that has led to several of her deaths. She's also jealous when attention is given to other women, and works to break up established couples if presented an opening. Extremely self-centered, she thinks nothing of manipulating others for her pleasure.    

Little is known of Tomie's true background, not even her family name. It is not known how she gained her powers, or even if she was aware of them prior to 1986. According to witnesses, she aged normally to that point, and seemed a standard if very pretty and flirtatious girl. On a field trip to Inariyawa, a small mountain near her school, Tomie was pressuring a teacher she'd been having sex with to leave his wife and marry her, when a male classmate who'd become obsessed with Tomie accosted her. She taunted the boy, and in the ensuing scuffle, Tomie fell over a cliff. Believing Tomie dead, the teacher decided to cover up the accident by chopping up the girl's body with the aid of the boys of the class. It turned out she wasn't quite dead, so this became a particularly gruesome task. The class then scattered the body parts where they would, in theory, not be found.  Some parts were found, identified as Tomie's, and cremated. Her death was blamed on a psychopath, and a funeral was held. Which made it rather a shock when Tomie walked into class the next day as if nothing had happened. Her reappearance drove the more susceptible members of the class to madness, and when two of them tried to go to the police, the others turned violent in an attempt to stop them. Tomie disappeared shortly thereafter.  

Tomie then began appearing in widely separated locations around Japan, inspiring men to passion and murder. She apparently died several more times, but always turned up alive again. Due to the police's stubborn refusal to credit these stories, no concerted effort was made to capture Tomie at least until 1995.   

([Source](https://www.herogames.com/forums/showthread.php?t=47566))

source.description:
The main character of the anime (novel). A soul who died and got another chance to re-enter the circle of reincarnation. He enters the body of a boy called Kobayashi Makoto who committed suicide. Now he has to find out what his own sin was and why Makoto died in a limited time or he is sent back.

~!It's later revealed that he's the soul of Makoto himself, so his sin was to commit suicide.!~
Makoto's mother.      ~!She had an affair with her Flamenco teacher. Makoto sees his mother leaving a love hotel and gets a shock. This is one of the reasons he commits suicide.!~
Makoto's father. A salary man who does a lot of overtime though he has no chance of getting promoted.
Makoto's older brother. He is very intelligent and studies hard to go to university. He and Makoto barely talk with each other.

The girl Makoto has a crush on.     ~!One of the reasons Makoto committed suicide was that he saw her coming out of a love hotel with a middle-aged man. Later Hiroka admits that she needs money to buy all the expensive things she wants. She offers Makoto ("I") to go the the love hotel together but he refuses.!~

A girl in Makoto's class. She is also in the art club like Makoto.     ~!Shouko seems to notice that Makoto changed after coming back to school (after committing suicide). It becomes clear that she was bullied by her classmates in the past. She admires Makoto because he was in the same position and stayed calm.!~

A boy in Makoto's class.     ~!"I" meets him in town and they become friends. They decide to go to the same high school and start studing together since they both have bad grades. Saotome may not be very handsome but he always talks to people with out making any difference.!~
A spirit that guides souls after death.   ~!He is a soul that was unable to reincarnate and so got a job from the "Boss" as a guardian spirit.!~
